Preserve exact user reference, raw review/requirements inputs, QA images and provenance with durable hash/path resolution. QA/input images do not count as generated originals.
Append only within the new prefix; all 2291 existing files and modes remain unchanged.
After concrete freeze and independent package pass, create an exact approved content tree and lease-protected commit/ref update; native PNG/JPEG bytes, no LFS pointers.
Independent live ref/commit/tree readback verifies all image/document hashes/sizes and the complete prior baseline.
One bounded additive verification child stores completed status and exact receipts without changing the frozen content.
